Agreed!

Putting ice in any form in whiskey is a big NO. You don't want it to be cold, because the molecules move more slowly therefore you lose some of the taste. And what's the point paying a fortune for Scotch if you're not going to taste it properly? Same as red wine, basically.

It's fine to add a little room-temperature water though.

Similarly beer and ale shouldn't be chilled.

Havent quite decided how I feel about ice in cider yet though…
